serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Sorry Annalie! I should’ve been there for you…
You: Is there anything I can help you with?
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.sad
Annalie: Now? Not really…
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: I already ordered most of the things for repairs including the windows. Once I get them, my shop will be like new!
You: I’m glad to hear that.
Annalie: If you really want to help me, you can do it the usual way.
#Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.pervy
Annalie: By buying a lot of clothes~
